approved_rate_policy.stage_index: Active part N is one-based; counter zero is not Part 1.
approved_rate_policy.later_parts: Offset clamps to 15 for Part 18 and later.
approved_rate_policy.movement_unit: One admitted enemy move advances horizontal FB by +/-1 byte (2 packed pixels) or vertical FB by +/-320 bytes (2 scanlines at 160 bytes/line); four substeps advance one 8-pixel cell.
approved_rate_policy.oracle: For N logical callbacks from phase zero with C fractional carries, admissions = C + floor((N-C)/2); displacement = N+C pixels within one pixel at the phase endpoint.
approved_rate_policy.preserved_policy: Keep Part 9's 1.0 reset, B2 maximum two logical ticks with excess debt discarded, existing CoCo 300-logical-tick freeze duration, death bypass, and all player/pose/AI/route/type-group behavior. No per-actor debt or generic cap.

worktree_contract.commit: one ticket-scoped commit after verification; parent owns integration

runtime_contract.requires: parent-reviewed hash-pinned per-phase dispatch receipt, current paired identities, matching BUG-086 receipt, and already-running XRoar monitor
runtime_contract.timeout: Fail the named phase; never infer speed or missing rare paths from timeout.

Each command requires its own --authorization <phase-auth.json>, --bug086-receipt <pinned receipt>, --baseline-identity <baseline-identity.json>, --candidate-identity <candidate-identity.json>, both localhost monitor ports, and a unique output receipt.

Each live command has a hard 45-second deadline and the exact read/write contract in its resolved phase. Only freeze-saturated-thaw may write the approved direct-page fixtures; other phases perform no state writes. Missing markers fail the phase.
